title: Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25K Grape GB / Strawberry GB Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: This duo pairs Grape Gummy Bear and Strawberry Gummy Bear for two confectionery-style takes on chewy fruit flavour. Designed for use with the Hayati Ultra 25K Prefilled Pod Kit, the pack combines a 2ml prefilled pod with two 10ml auto-refilling containers so both refills can be fitted at once and switched at the device. Setup is quick and tidy with no refilling or coil changes required. A mesh coil and 20mg Nic Salt provide consistent MTL vapour and swift nicotine satisfaction from either gummy-inspired flavour. How to Set Up Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25K Pods Step 1 Remove all protective seals from the 2ml pod and both 10ml refill containers. Step 2 Click the 2ml pod into the mouthpiece module. Step 3 Align and click up to two 10ml auto-refilling containers into the mouthpiece. Step 4 Insert the assembled unit into the device. Step 5 Allow a short moment for the coil to saturate before vaping. ✅ You're all set!
